scientific_integrity: Uniform unrestricted proof via weighted Hall feasibility and a matching explicit Lipschitz dual witness. Exact arithmetic finite enumeration independently checks 745 cases; it is not an exhaustive certificate for arbitrary sizes or real parameters. Self-review only; no independent mathematical audit.
scientific_limitations: Finite real multipartite metric spaces only; uniform cross-distance one, a constant within-part distance in [1,2] independently chosen per part; no weighted cross distances, irregular within-part costs, W_p for p>1, or uniqueness of optimal coupling.
title: Universal transport plans and affine Lipschitz-free norms for independently weighted multipartite metrics
